edge_explainer.market_believes: The June deal reopened the strait — the war trade is over; Frontline round-tripped the whole spike.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The reopening stalled at a third of normal traffic: insurance still costs 8x baseline, Qatar extended force majeure into September, and charter rates are printing at multiples of normal — yet the stock is priced at its exact pre-war level, as if none of that revenue was arriving. Q2 is already locked at ~6x normal rates; Q3 elevation comes free at this price.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Thin and honest: attention to the weekly transit tape vs a market that declared the episode over in five sessions. Everyone watches this trade — the edge is discipline, not discovery.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: The stall might resolve any week — owners returned fast after the MoU and a full reopening takes our upside with it; that outcome is 60% our own number.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Weekly transit counts + war-risk premia (the tripwires); FRO Q2 earnings ~late Aug (Q3 bookings %); the Aug-31 frozen-call adjudication.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Transits >40/day with premia <0.4% and spot rates <2x normal in the same week = fully reopened: exit, thesis over.
